scope: Only root-authorized old failures, R02/R03/R04 opposite variants, GC development cases and actual Plan-confirmed38 output. No sealed CS cases or future works.
requiredPrerequisites: Final frozen hypothesis and regression protocol paths plus hashes
Explicit allowed caseId list and exact source/answer/preparation/writer/final paths
Evidence provenance for every reviewed path: fresh live, saved-response offline replay or reused closed baseline
principles: Quoted-source matching and model self-check are locators, not semantic proof.
Use the whole original source and all actual answers, including independent restrictions, before judging any generated clause.
A wrong preparation corrected in the writer is recorded separately from an error surviving final assembly.
Useful internal completion, factual assumptions, user prerequisites and new independent artifacts are judged separately.
Missing evidence cannot be recorded as a pass. Regression PASS does not establish unseen quality, downstream gains, adoption or deployment.
